endpoint_definition: high_burden_state_dpf6_TRUTH=1 only when the planted state at 6 dpf is the high-burden state (state 2); prior high-state membership is not required.
dose_index_definition: cumulative_pressure_burden_kpa_hits=synthetic measured peak kPa multiplied by hit count; units are kPa-hits and it is not a measured pressure integral.
critical_caveat: The papers do not report repeated daily LFP from the same TBI larvae at 4-6 dpf. This longitudinal schedule, all numerical emissions, the 195 kPa center, and all DeepLabCut values are simulator assumptions.
